name: Barclays Arrival Plus® World Elite Mastercard®

localized_names.en: Barclays Arrival Plus® World Elite Mastercard®

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: Annual fee waived first year, then $89 billed every twelve months after account opening.

apr.notes: Variable APR 18.24%, 22.24% or 25.24% based on creditworthiness. 0% introductory APR for 12 months on balance transfers made within 45 days of account opening. Balance transfer fee: $5 or 3% of each transfer, whichever is greater.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made while traveling abroad.

base_rate.description: Earn unlimited 2X miles on every purchase.

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem miles for travel statement credits toward qualifying travel purchases of $100 or more made within the last 120 days. Get 5% miles back to use toward your next redemption, every time you redeem. Minimum redemption within the travel statement credit category is 2,500 miles.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 70,000 bonus miles after spending $5,000 on purchases in the first 90 days — enough to redeem for a $700 travel statement credit toward qualifying travel purchase.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made while traveling abroad.

benefits.title: International Chip and PIN
benefits.description: International Chip and PIN for use at self-service Chip terminals around the world.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability Protection
benefits.description: $0 Fraud Liability protection means you're not responsible for unauthorized charges.

benefits.title: 5% Miles Back on Redemption
benefits.description: Get 5% miles back to use toward your next redemption, every time you redeem.

notes: Closed to new applicants in 2019. Still exists for legacy cardholders. Earned unlimited 2x miles on every purchase with 5% miles back on redemption. $89 annual fee waived first year. No foreign transaction fees. Verified from Wayback Machine snapshot of the official Barclays product page (Jan 2019).
